    Descent of presilting differentials carrying a Galois action #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_presilting_of_descent {k F R : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsGalois k F] (P : TwoTerm (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (ρ : DescentAction k F R P.source) (τ : DescentAction k F R P.target) (hf : ∀ (σ : Gal(F/k)) (x : ↑P.source), (ModuleCat.Hom.hom P.differential.hom) ((ρ.action σ) x) = (τ.action σ) ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom P.differential.hom) x)) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), Q.IsPresilting ∧ Nonempty (extendObj k F R Q.source ≅ P.source) ∧ Nonempty (extendObj k F R Q.target ≅ P.target)

    A presilting differential compatible with descent actions descends to a presilting two-term complex.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_presilting_of_extended_terms_of_descent {k F R : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsGalois k F] (P : TwoTerm (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (ρ : DescentAction k F R P.source) (τ : DescentAction k F R P.target) (hf : ∀ (σ : Gal(F/k)) (x : ↑P.source), (ModuleCat.Hom.hom P.differential.hom) ((ρ.action σ) x) = (τ.action σ) ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom P.differential.hom) x)) (A B : FiniteProjective R) (a : P.source ≅ extendObj k F R ↑A) (b : P.target ≅ extendObj k F R ↑B) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), Q.IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = ProjectiveClass.of B - ProjectiveClass.of A

    Descent of a presilting differential on extended projective terms produces their ground projective class.
